title: Cloud IAM Kubernetes Analysis Foundation
goal: Move from cloud inventory toward safe read-only cloud/IAM/Kubernetes risk analysis without mutating customer resources.
scope: After cloud inventory discovery exists, add first-pass read-only analysis for IAM policy risks, public exposure, security-group issues, and Kubernetes configuration signals where supported. Keep exploitation and resource mutation out of scope.
generation_reason: Product recommendation coverage audit found cloud IAM and Kubernetes analysis was not explicit beyond inventory discovery.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Read-only analysis only. Do not mutate cloud resources, execute exploit chains, or request broader permissions than needed.
notes: Cloud credentials must use protected secret binding patterns.
Provider-specific unsupported states must be explicit.

success_criteria: Supported cloud inventory can be analyzed for selected IAM, exposure, and configuration risk signals.
Kubernetes signals are included only where safe read-only inputs are available.
Findings or analysis output are evidence-backed and provider-scoped.
Tests cover supported provider data, missing permission, and unsupported-provider fallbacks.
No cloud resource mutation or exploitation is introduced.
must_not_touch: pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: Missing permissions are explicit and non-fatal.
No cloud mutation or exploitation path is added.

before_promotion: The prior active task is completed and logged.
The cloud inventory foundation exists or the task is narrowed to documentation-only readiness.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with cloud/IAM/Kubernetes analysis changes and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the cloud analysis baseline and remaining cloud limits.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.
